messages:
Ethan: Heads up — need quick sync on Q3 roadmap: embeddings + rerank consolidation. Customers asking for cheaper rerank with high precision. Who can join?
Priya: I'm in. need clarity on accept criteria and perf targets.
Lina: Can we define a minimum quality delta vs current reranker? customers care about top-3 precision and latency.
Maya: Suggest metrics: top-3 NDCG >= 0.92 (current 0.94), p95 latency <= 120ms, cost per 1k queries < $0.60.
Tom: Those numbers seem reasonable. Also add rollback plan if quality drops >2%.
Ethan: Agree. Also tradeoff table: quantized reranker vs combo of embeddings + lightweight rerank.
Priya: We should test small customer cohort (2 customers) for canary for 3 weeks.
Lina: Dev work: model variants + auto-fallback by policy. Who owns build? @Maya?
Maya: I can own build + canary infra. Need eng-runtime to expose fallback hook.
Tom: eng-runtime OK — will add an opt-in route flag and logs. ETA for infra: 2 sprints.
Ethan: Launch criteria checklist:
```
- perf tests passed (p95/p99)
- regression < 1% on eval set
- canary stable 3w
- docs and pricing ok
```
Priya: Add customer comms and migration guide.
Lina: Also add cost simulation table for Dedicated vs Hosted.
Maya: I'll mock numbers. Need product sign-off by 2190210000 (two weeks).
Tom: Ops: SLA impact? assume none if fallback works.
deploy-bot: scheduled canary window: 2190500000 -> 2190700000 (placeholder) :rocket:
Ethan: Action items: Maya build, Tom infra, Priya comms+signoff, Lina evals. Next check-in Friday. :calendar:
Priya: noted. I'll draft signoff template.
Lina: I'll start eval runs tonight.
Maya: putting a PR up by EOD.
Ethan: thanks all. keep updates in this thread. :thumbsup:
